meta.name: ingest
meta.description: Fetch requested source material and prepare sourced engagement updates. Use to catch up from external notes or messages; applying updates requires a bound record and confirmation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取指定来源的内容,整理成带出处的进展更新,确认后再写入记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要从外部笔记或聊天里同步信息并更新记录
copy.tagline_en: Pull in notes and messages into sourced updates you confirm before applying
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you sync info from outside notes or chats into records

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会抓取你指定的来源材料,整理成带出处的 engagement 更新草稿;真正应用更新需要绑定记录并经过确认,未绑定的草稿不会被当作已存入记录。
howto.when: 当你要从外部笔记或消息里补进度、追平时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则复用它当前的脱敏包与范围,不重启设置和已经问过的问题。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude fetches the source material you name and prepares a sourced engagement update draft. Applying updates requires a bound record plus confirmation; an unbound draft isn't saved to engagement memory.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to catch up from external notes or messages. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Draft a sourced update from these external notes.
say_en.note: Produces a draft; nothing is applied.

say_en.text: Turn these messages into an engagement update to confirm.
Continue with @fde's current sanitized packet and scope.
